blocks.text: Unlock the vaults! A glimpse of gothic Britain – in pictures
A new exhibition has trawled the Martin Parr Foundation’s archive to find these haunted images – revealing the UK as a place of fear and fascination

blocks.alt: Mourners gather among gravestones at a cemetery in Kensal Rise, 1988

blocks.text: and the Gothic runs at the Martin Parr Foundation, Bristol, until 20 December

links.text: and the Gothic runs at the Martin Parr Foundation, Bristol, until 20 December

blocks.alt: A furnace keeper slumps over a table in a tiled, worn ironworks mess room

blocks.text: Graham Smith, Thirty Eight Bastard Years on the Furnace Front, Furnace Keeper, Mess room for Number 4 and Number 5 Furnaces, Clay Lane Ironworks, South Bank, Middlesbrough, 1983

blocks.alt: A woman pushes a pram across a muddy site, smoking factory chimneys behind, in Consett

blocks.text: Don McCullin, Woman With Pram, Consett, 1974

blocks.alt: An abandoned Victorian mansion in Leeds, overgrown with tall weeds and decaying facade
Guests at a Conservative Party fundraiser mingle on a lawn outside a house

blocks.text: Martin Parr, Conservative Party fundraiser, England, 1988

blocks.alt: A prison cell with a single bed, folded sheets, and a floral curtain beside a barred window

blocks.text: Donovan Wylie, The Maze/Long Kesh Prison, Prison Cell H — Block 5, B — Wing, 18/24, 2002-2003

blocks.alt: Jordi the lounge lizard lies asleep in uniform on an ornate sofa

blocks.text: Chris Shaw, Jordi the Lounge Lizzard, The Howard Hotel, London 1999-2000

blocks.alt: In Derry, a police officer stands near a burning cart and wrecked car outside brick buildings

blocks.text: Akihiko Okamura, Derry Londonderry, Northern Ireland, at around 4 PM on August 12, 1969

blocks.alt: Coal scavengers in coats bend over, picking through a rocky slope of rubble

blocks.text: Colin Jones, Coal Scavengers Working On A Mound, Sunderland, North East of England, 1962

blocks.alt: A steelworker in a protective mask stands near a blazing furnace amid smoke

blocks.text: Janine Wiedel, Shelton Bar Iron and Steel Works in Stoke on Trent in 1978 just before it was closed down with loss of 2,500 jobs

blocks.alt: A lit cursive “Boots” sign hangs on a grimy wall above wooden crates in a dim warehouse

blocks.text: Sarah Pickering, Boots, 2008, from the series Incident

blocks.alt: A wooden raft of carrots floats on a calm river beside reeds and overgrown banks

blocks.text: Jem Southam, The Raft of Carrots, 1987-1992
